body.name: Legal stationary assignment laws
body.construction: \(\mathfrak D_{\infty}=\{P_{\infty}\in\Delta(\{-1,+1\}^{\mathbb Z}):P_{\infty}\ \text{is shift invariant},\ P_{\infty}(B)=P_{\infty}(-B)\ \text{for every }B,\ \mathbb E_{P_{\infty}}[X_0^{\infty}X_h^{\infty}]=0\ \text{for every }h\ne0\}\).
